evidence: frames sampled at 1.5, 2.5, 5.6, 14.6, 16.7 s at x=100 y=100

value.description: Heavy condensed grotesque in capitals, white on blue. Tight tracking. Width share of frame by importance: 'EVERY 2 WEEKS' 61%, 'START' 56%, 'TO ENTER' 81-88%, 'START TRADING' 70%. Line-height about 1.0 when stacked. Font is inferred: something in the family of Druk or Tungsten Condensed.
Same condensed face in mixed case, blue on paper, at 16-50% width. Starts small: 'Perps' is only 16% of the width, so it reads as a whisper.
Neutral grotesque in semibold (Inter-like, inferred) on paper, about 28% width. Condensed heavy on banknote ground ('$10K' 35%). Proportional figures: the width jitters as digits change.
Neutral grotesque regular, white, 30% width, with a dim grey second line at about 10% cap height. Deliberately quiet.
Real-looking interface type at true product scale: not enlarged, so it reads as the real thing rather than a slide.

composition.value: One centred element on an empty ground; the only full-bleed composition is the interface or the ranking. Text is optically centred at about 50% height and never sits in a corner. Scale is the only hierarchy: the frame is 60-85% empty. Stacked lines are centred and the same width by size choice rather than by letter-spacing. Backgrounds carry a single faint layer at 6-12% contrast: rings, an engraved banknote, a trophy, tiles or a giant cropped ghost of the word, each drifting.

materials.value: Flat colour for the type scenes. Three physical objects interrupt it: a glossy orange coin with a thick lit rim (6.5-7.1 s), white paper with a curled bottom and a torn edge (22-23.8 s), a blue gradient chart whose bars darken at the top (3.4-3.8 s). Tickers sit on white cards with hairline-free soft shadows and a pale green gradient below the line.

lighting.value: Only the objects are lit. The coin has a moving highlight and the slip a slow diagonal sheen (visible F708-F714). Paper sits on pure black with no floor or shadow, so it floats.

styleSummary: Announcement built from a tiny, strict kit: one blue, one condensed face, one centred element, hard cuts between three grounds. The richness comes from three short object moments and from every number being animated.
